attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 (RHEL 7.9) with the specified ed25519 public key for SSH access and enforced key-based-only SSH authentication (PasswordAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no). Verified end-to-end via live SSH: pubkey login succeeds, password/keyboard-interactive login is refused. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol on node1, proving boot_id changed and that sshd, the opsadmin account, its authorized_keys, and the key-only auth policy all survived the reboot intact.
